subject: Post-demo budget anchor & early-stage credit request
messages:

Subject: Post-demo budget anchor & early-stage credit request

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and a couple of asks to help us land an actionable proposal:

- Fit: You confirmed the primary use case is conversational search over proprietary docs + a small generative assistant for support triage. Latency target ~300ms p95 for queries, and peak QPS is expected during business hours.
- Token profile: You said avg request size ~750 tokens (prompt + response) and expect 1.5M–4M tokens/day in early months (ramping).

To get you a concrete startup/commit pricing proposal we need two quick confirmations:
1) A budget anchor / target $/1M tokens that would make Redwood economical for you (ballpark is fine).
2) Will you consider a 3–12 month pilot that transitions into a committed-use discount if we hit a volume threshold?

I pulled together a short pricing workbook (attached) with a couple of starter paths: founder credit + short pilot, or a 12-month commit for better unit economics. If you can send a single-line confirmation of your target $/1M and whether a pilot-to-commit path is acceptable, I’ll circulate a formal offer.

Next step: if you’re free, let’s lock a 30-min follow-up Thursday to walk the numbers together.

Attachments: greenfield_pricing_workbook.xlsx

—
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex — great demo and useful workbook. Quick answers from our side:

- Budget anchor: at the moment we’re planning for $3,000–$4,000 per 1M tokens initially; our stretch target to be comfortable is ~ $2,500/1M but that requires a meaningful credit or committed discount.
- Pilot: yes — we prefer a 3-month pilot (production traffic, limited scale) that can convert to a 12-month commitment if latency and costs look good.

We’re pre-Series A, so founder-friendly credits and simpler commercial docs are important for us. If you can outline a pilot + founders credit option and a committed pricing path (12-month), that would be most helpful.

Also looping in Samir who owns ops budget — Samir, we’ll need an internal yes/no on runway for the pilot.

—
Priya Shah
Head of Product, Greenfield AI
priya@greenfield.ai

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo budget anchor & early-stage credit request

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Priya’s response. They gave a budget anchor of $3k–$4k per 1M and prefer a 3-month pilot that converts to 12-month commit. Greenfield is pre-Series A and asked for founder-friendly terms.

Proposed starting offer (feel free to adjust):
- Founder credit: $25k upfront credit applied to usage during first 6 months.
- Pilot: 3-month pilot priced at $900 per 1M tokens (cap 100M tokens/month during pilot).
- Commit path: 12-month committed plan (post-pilot) at $800 per 1M tokens for a 600M tokens/year minimum (can be structured monthly with annualized commitment).
- Multi-year incentive: If they sign 24 months, give an incremental 5% rebate in year 2.

Rationale: aggressive pilot price to remove friction; commit price still delivers predictable revenue and a clear step-down. Greenfield’s budget anchor suggests a need for sizable upfront credit to hit their target of ~$2.5–3k effective in early months.

Can we approve founder credit at $25k and pilot pricing above? Also confirm whether legal is okay with a 6-month credit window and a simple DocuSign MSA for startup deals.

—
Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo budget anchor & early-stage credit request

Thanks Alex — I like the structure, but I recommend the following tweaks to protect unit economics while staying founder-friendly:

- Increase Founder credit to $30k (to reduce sticker shock and get more runway).
- Pilot rate: approve $900/1M with the 100M/month cap, but include an overage rate of $1,400/1M past cap during pilot.
- Commit pricing: $850/1M for a 12-month commit at a 600M token annualized minimum (flexible monthly drawdown), with performance CLA that if monthly avg >120M in any quarter we reassess routing to Dedicated capacity/pricing.
- Multi-year: 24-month combo gives an additional 5% price reduction in year 2 (applied to committed unit price).

Legal: startup MSA template is fine but ask legal to keep the founder credit application simple (credit applied to invoices until exhausted or up to 6 months). I’ll approve the commercial terms — go ahead and present to them.

—
Ben
